description: Providing Official Communication Facilities for accelerating the Digitalization Process of the Judicial System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-12-15, to implement the 'e-court' project aimed at digitizing all courts in Sri Lanka. As the initial step of this project, digital systems for case management are currently being developed for Magistrate's Courts, District Courts, and High Courts. A fundamental requirement for this initiative is the provision of official email facilities to officials at all levels of the judicial system. Furthermore, the need to provide 'Voice-to-Text' technology which converts spoken statements into written text in real-time, has been identified as a solution to the current shortage of stenographers in the courts. Similarly, in accordance with the provisions of the Code of Criminal Procedure (Amendment) Act, No.07 of 2025 and the Assistance to and Protection of Victims of Crime and Witnesses Act, No.4 of 2015, video conferencing facilities must be provided to all courts to enable online court hearings. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to initially provide 1,050 official email accounts bearing the 'courts.gov.lk' domain to 350 courts under the Government's official information portal (gov.lk), and to host the proposed 1,050 official email accounts through the email system currently utilized by the Ministry of Justice and National Integration, which includes integrated Voice-to-Text and Video Conferencing features, was approved by the Cabinet.
